protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: declarative MCP on Worker/Manager/Team CRDs (breaking) and on Team Leader
protocol_standardization.note: Higress hosts MCP servers; MCP configurable per Worker.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The Manager delegates work to a Worker or Team and tracks progress in Matrix rooms.
loop_primitives.note: AgentTeams orchestrates agent containers; inner loop belongs to runtimes (OpenClaw/QwenPaw/Hermes).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The Manager decides whether to use an existing Worker, create a Worker, or organize a Team.
planning_granularity.note: TeamHarness project/task runtime exists but no plan object documented in evidence.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Built on a **Manager-Workers architecture**, AgentTeams features a Manager that centrally orchestrates multiple Workers

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Manager: Done. Worker alice is ready.
delegation_mechanism.note: Manager asks controller to create Worker containers/Pods and delegates tasks via Matrix rooms.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Every Matrix room includes you, the Manager, and the relevant Workers. Watch everything. Jump in anytime. No black boxes.
human_in_loop.note: Humans observe and intervene mid-task; approval of decisions mentioned in docs/overview.md.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: AgentTeams models the system through four declarative resources: `Worker`, `Manager`, `Team`, and `Human`.
short_term_state.note: CR status plus project/workflow inspection API.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Workers pull from [skills.sh](https://skills.sh) (80,000+ community skills) on demand.
long_term_memory.note: Shared MinIO object storage keeps agent workspaces, context and artifacts across Worker replacement.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Agent configuration and persistent data live in centralized object storage, so Worker environments can be replaced.
state_persistence.note: Also worker_checkpoints.go in controller server package.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Token Plan + Qwen Cloud international + `qwen3.6-plus`, namespace-scoped controller RBAC
cost_controls.note: v1.2.0-beta.1 adds model-provider routing and LLM preflight.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Per-request timeout for the LLM preflight HTTP probe. Defaults to `30`
timeouts.note: Only preflight timeout documented; no agent run timeout in evidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: it orchestrates and manages multiple Agent containers (including the Manager and numerous Workers).
execution_isolation.note: Line number not available in the excerpt; Docker is a prerequisite per Quick Start.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Manager and Worker containers/Pods | Run the agent runtimes. They are separated from infrastructure and can be created or replaced on demand.
filesystem_access.note: Full access within the container boundary; shared state in MinIO.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Higress uses separate identities and consumer credentials to control model and tool access.
network_policy.note: LLM/MCP traffic routed through the gateway; general egress not documented.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Higress | Acts as the AI/API gateway for LLM and MCP traffic, identity, and access control.
permission_model.note: Gateway consumer credentials authorize model/tool calls per Worker identity.

tracing.evidence_quote: Export debug logs (Matrix messages + agent sessions, PII auto-redacted)
tracing.note: JSONL debug logs; AgentLoop integration provides full-stack observability and auditing.

replayability.evidence_quote: make replay TASK="Create a Worker named alice for frontend development"

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: make test # Build + run all integration tests
eval_hooks.note: Integration tests, not benchmark evaluation; AgentLoop provides Agent evaluation externally.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Coordinate specialized Workers for frontend, backend, testing, research, or other roles.
target_domain.note: MCP tool access via gateway; QwenPaw suited to browser automation.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Choose your LLM provider (OpenAI-compatible APIs supported)
